packages.title: High-frequency water chemistry timeseries data from the Upper Kuparuk River and Oksrukuyik Creek, Alaska, 2017-2019 and 2021-2023
packages.abstract: Rapid climate change in the Arctic is expected to enhance lateral fluxes of organic carbon and nutrients from thawing soils to Arctic rivers. However, the seasonal and landscape drivers of Arctic riverine solute flux remain poorly understood. To understand changing patterns of solute flux within Arctic headwater catchments, we collected high-frequency measurements of water quality and meteorological data at the outlet of two catchments on the North Slope of Alaska: the Upper Kuparuk River catchment and Oksrukuyik Creek. From early June to late August across six years, we monitored dissolved organic carbon (DOC) and nitrate (NO3-) concentrations (2017-2019, 2021-2023), turbidity and specific conductance (2022-2023), pH, dissolved oxygen, water temperature, photosynthetically active radiation, and other meteorological parameters (2021-2023) at 15-minute intervals.

packages.title: Riverine dissolved organic carbon and nitrate transport during storm events, Kuparuk River and Oksrukuyik Creek, North Slope Alaska (2017-2019 and 2021-2023)
packages.abstract: As Arctic hydrological cycles intensify and permafrost thaws, precipitation events are important windows of solute export from Arctic catchments, yet the processes that underpin carbon and nutrient transport during these events remain poorly understood. Clarifying these drivers is crucial to understanding how advancing climate change will alter riverine carbon and nutrient fluxes in rapidly changing Arctic catchments. To address this knowledge gap, we delineated storm events from early June to late August across six years (2017-2019 and 2021-2023) of high-frequency monitoring in two Arctic headwater catchments on Alaska's North Slope: the Upper Kuparuk River and Oksrukuyik Creek. For each storm, we calculated storm event yield, hysteresis index and flushing index of dissolved organic carbon and nitrate. We also extracted several storm event characteristics including storm water yield, storm duration, peak discharge, rising limb duration, and the time since the preceding storm.

entities.entity_description: This dataset contains continuous high-frequency (15-minute) water chemistry and meteorological time series data from the outlets of two Arctic headwater catchments: the Upper Kuparuk River and Oksrukuyik Creek. We monitored these catchments from early June to late August of 2017-2019 and 2021-2023.

attributes.name: Watershed
attributes.definition: Watershed name, as either "Kuparuk River" or "Oksrukuyik Creek"

attributes.name: Monitoring_Site
attributes.definition: Latitude and longitude coordinates (in decimal degrees) at each outlet monitoring site. The data is stored as a string, comma-separated coordinate pair, in the format 'latitude, longitude'.

attributes.name: Date
attributes.definition: Date of measurement as M/D/YY

attributes.name: Time
attributes.definition: Measurement time as HH:MM:SS

attributes.name: DateTime_AKDT
attributes.definition: Measurement date and time, as M/D/YY, HH:MM:SS.

attributes.name: Year
attributes.definition: Year of measurement, either 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, or 2023

attributes.name: BaroPressure_mbar
attributes.definition: Barometric pressure (millibars) measured on weather stations deployed on the stream bank of each monitoring site.

attributes.name: Windspeed_m.s
attributes.definition: Wind speed (meters per second) measured on weather stations deployed on the stream bank of each monitoring site.

attributes.name: Gustspeed_m.s
attributes.definition: Wind gust speed (meters per second) measured on weather stations deployed on the stream bank of each monitoring site.

attributes.name: Winddirection.phi
attributes.definition: Wind direction (degrees) measured on weather stations deployed on the stream bank of each monitoring site.

attributes.name: Rain_mm
attributes.definition: Rainfall volume (mm) measured with a rain gauge on weather stations deployed on the stream bank of each monitoring site.

attributes.name: AirTemp_C
attributes.definition: Air temperature (degrees Celsius) measured on weather stations deployed on the stream bank of each monitoring site.

attributes.name: RelHumid_percent
attributes.definition: Relative humidity (%) measured on weather stations deployed on the stream bank of each monitoring site.

attributes.name: SolRad_W.m2
attributes.definition: Solar radiation (watts per square meter) measured on weather stations deployed on the stream bank of each monitoring site.

attributes.name: PAR_umol.m2.s1
attributes.definition: Photosynthetically active radiation (micromoles per square meter per second) measured on PAR microstation sensors deployed on the stream bank of each monitoring site.

attributes.name: DO_mg.L
attributes.definition: Dissolved oxygen concentration (milligrams per liter) measured on in-situ sensors deployed in the stream at each monitoring site.

attributes.name: Watertemp_C
attributes.definition: Water temperature (degrees Celsius) measured on in-situ sensors deployed in the stream at each monitoring site.

attributes.name: pH
attributes.definition: pH measured on in-situ sensors deployed in the stream at each monitoring site.

attributes.name: SpC_uS.cm
attributes.definition: Specific conductivity (microsiemens per centimeter) measured on in-situ sensors deployed in the stream at each monitoring site.

attributes.name: DOC_mg.L
attributes.definition: Dissolved organic carbon concentration (milligrams per liter) measured on in-situ sensors deployed in the stream at each monitoring site.

attributes.name: NO3_mg.L
attributes.definition: Nitrate concentration (milligrams per liter) measured on in-situ sensors deployed in the stream at each monitoring site.

attributes.name: Turbidity_FTU
attributes.definition: Turbidity (FTU) measured on in-situ sensors deployed in the stream at each monitoring site.

attributes.name: Abs254_cm
attributes.definition: Absorbance at 254nm (inverse centimeters) measured on in-situ sensors deployed in the stream at each monitoring site.

attributes.name: suva254_L.mgC.m
attributes.definition: Specific UV absorbance at 254nm (liters per milligram-C per meter). Calculated by converting abs254 to units of inverse meters and dividing by DOC concentration.

attributes.name: Notes
attributes.definition: Important information about field conditions

entities.entity_description: This dataset contains storm-event characteristics (including storm duration, peak discharge, rising limb duration, and inter-storm lag time) along with associated storm solute export metrics such as storm water, DOC, and NO3- yields, and hysteresis and flushing indices, derived from high-frequency water chemistry and discharge monitoring between early June and late August across six years (2017-2019, 2021-2023) in two Arctic headwater catchments. The data capture storm-scale differences in hydrologic behavior and carbon and nutrient export between the Upper Kuparuk River and Oksrukuyik Creek on Alaska's North Slope.

attributes.name: watershed
attributes.definition: Watershed name, as either "Kuparuk River (River-dominated)" or "Oksrukuyik Creek (Lake-influenced)"

attributes.name: year
attributes.definition: Year of measurement, either 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, or 2023

attributes.name: doc.yield_kgkm2
attributes.definition: Dissolved organic carbon (DOC) yield calculated by integrating DOC load over discharge for the duration of each storm event, producing a total export mass per event in kilograms normalized by catchment area (kg/km2).

attributes.name: no3.yield_kgkm2
attributes.definition: Nitrate (NO3-) yield calculated by integrating NO3- load over discharge for the duration of each storm event, producing a total export mass per event in kilograms normalized by catchment area (kg/km2).

attributes.name: Q.yield_mm
attributes.definition: Storm water yield was calculated by integrating discharge over the duration of the event to estimate total runoff volume, and then normalized by catchment area.

attributes.name: time.start
attributes.definition: Storm start date and time (MM/DD/YY HH:MM:SS)

attributes.name: time.end
attributes.definition: Storm end date and time (MM/DD/YY HH:MM:SS)

attributes.name: duration_hrs
attributes.definition: Storm duration calculated as the number of hours between the storm start and storm end.

attributes.name: peak.Q_m3s
attributes.definition: Maximum storm discharge (cubic meters per second)

attributes.name: rise.limb_hrs
attributes.definition: Storm rising limb duration calculated as the number of hours between storm onset and maximum discharge.

attributes.name: storm.lag_hrs
attributes.definition: Number of hours between storm events. For the first recorded storm of each thaw season, storm.lag_hrs is recorded as NA.

attributes.name: HI.NO3
attributes.definition: Nitrate (NO3-) storm hysteresis index (HI), unitless.

attributes.name: HI.DOC
attributes.definition: Dissolved organic carbon (DOC) storm hysteresis index (HI), unitless.

attributes.name: FI.DOC
attributes.definition: Dissolved organic carbon (DOC) storm flushing index (FI), unitless

attributes.name: FI.NO3
attributes.definition: Nitrate (NO3-) storm flushing index (FI), unitless.
